description.value: The Okanagan Falls Branch is part of the Okanagan Regional Library system, one of the largest public library networks in British Columbia, serving over 399,000 people across 30 branches. Located on Railway Lane in the heart of Okanagan Falls, this small branch offers public computer terminals, community programming, and a book drop accessible around the clock. It serves as a quiet, climate-controlled stop for passing cyclists looking to connect online or take a break.

address.value: 850 Railway Lane, Unit 101, Okanagan Falls, BC V0H 1R4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Okanagan Falls Branch confirms the address (#101 850 Railway Lane), phone number (250) 497-5886, and that the branch is open and active with upcoming events. The site notes free parking in front of the building and three public computers with internet access, but does not explicitly mention bike racks, washrooms, WiFi for personal devices, or water refill. The OSM tag internet_access=wlan is not confirmed via the website for personal-device WiFi, so it is left null per the rules.
